members.name: relative_strength_index_divergence_v1
members.thesis: When a liquid NIFTY 50 constituent diverges significantly from NIFTY 50's intraday move (e.g., NIFTY up 0.5% but stock flat or down), it creates a relative value opportunity. The stock tends to catch up as index-tracking flows (ETFs, passive) and arbitrageurs push constituent weights back in line. T
members.exit_stop: 0.6% from entry or residual_zscore hits -3.5 (for longs)
filters: no trades first 15 min or last 20 min
stock volume must be > 80% of 20-bar avg
prefer trades where stock diverges from index direction
weaknesses: Beta estimation error: using 20-day rolling beta is noisy. If beta is wrong, the residual signal is contaminated. Consider using 60-day beta instead.
Idiosyncratic events (stock-specific news) cause legitimate divergence from index. Without a real-time news filter, you'll occasionally catch the wrong side of a company-specific move.
During sector rotation days, entire sectors diverge from NIFTY — multiple names fire simultaneously, creating correlated risk that looks like diversification but isn't.
members.prior_art: Index arbitrage / relative value. See: Algorithmic Trading (Chan), pairs trading literature. This is a simplified single-stock version.

members.exit_stop: basis_z exceeds 3.5 OR total basket loss > 0.3%
filters: none (trade in all VIX regimes, but increase z threshold to 2.5 if VIX > 20)
all 10 components must have traded > 5000 shares in current 1-min bar
weaknesses: 10-leg execution is complex; partial fills on any leg create unhedged exposure and tracking error against the index
The top-10 basket only captures ~55% of NIFTY weight, so basis calculations have inherent noise from the other 40 stocks
F&O expiry weeks cause basis to behave anomalously due to rollover dynamics, creating false signals
